ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 41/2023/ND-CP (30 June 2023) detailing the AML Law; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN (29 December 2023) of the State Bank of Viet Nam on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14; Decree No. 155/2020/ND-CP; Decision No. 11/2018/QD-TTg of the Prime Minister prescribing high-risk jurisdictions and tax havens requiring enhanced due diligence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the corporate shareholder (including the ultimate beneficial owners' constitutional documents covering the full ownership chain)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation (e.g., ACRA for Singapore; Companies House for the UK; Secretary of State for US states)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent Apostille authority of the country of origin (Viet Nam has been a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention since 1 March 2011); non-Contracting States require consular legalization through the Vietnamese Embassy or Consulate with prior certification by the issuing country's Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder approving the incorporation of the Viet Nam LLC, designating the legal representative, and authorizing signature on the Investment Registration Certificate dossier
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary or notary public in the shareholder's country of incorporation, authenticated by corporate seal and director signatures
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for Contracting States) or consular legalization (for non-Contracting States); the resolution must be certified against the official corporate register of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements of the corporate investor or a bank capital-availability confirmation letter evidencing the ability to contribute the charter capital and to maintain licensed capital for the multi-family office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered public accounting firm (auditor) or licensed commercial bank in the investor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; alternatively, a legalized banker's letter addressed to the Vietnamese bank operating the indirect investment capital account (IICA/DICA) for the LLC

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the passport / national identity document of every natural-person ultimate beneficial owner and the proposed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or civil identification authority of the UBO's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the country of origin followed by Hague Apostille (if a Contracting State) or consular legalization by the Overseas Mission of Viet Nam (if a non-Contracting State)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police / penal record certificate (judicial record certificate) of the proposed legal representative and General Director evidencing no criminal conviction, required for enterprise registration and securities licence application
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial record authority / central criminal records office of the person's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization (preferred by Vietnamese regulators for non-Hague states) or Hague Apostille where the country is a Contracting State; the certificate must be issued within 90 days of the submission date

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based AML/CFT protocol aligned with FATF recommendations: (i) full customer due diligence (CDD) and beneficial-owner identification at the 25% ownership threshold; (ii) enhanced due diligence (EDD) for all politically exposed persons (PEPs), including foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, and international-organization PEPs as defined in Clause 3, Article 4 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15; (iii) continuous screening of the MFO principals, client families, their counterparties, custodians, and all Swift interbank / custody-wire payment rails against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and HM Treasury financial sanctions targets, and the Vietnamese blacklist prescribed in Decision No. 11/2018/QD-TTg; (iv) affirmative obligation to report suspicious transactions to the State Bank of Viet Nam's Anti-Money Laundering Information Center (AMLIC) not later than 48 hours after identification (Article 32, Law No. 14/2022/QH15); and (v) documentary retention for a minimum of five years in accordance with Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) administered by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment; provincial clearance and result notification is performed by the Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng ký kinh doanh) of the relevant provincial Department of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be written in the Vietnamese national script (Quốc ngữ - Vietnamese alphabet with diacritical marks) and must be pronounceable in Vietnamese; the name may include digits, the symbols '&' and '.', and a Roman-script foreign element as a short name or abbreviated name, but must not be identical or confusingly similar to an already-registered name. For a limited liability company, the full registered name must contain the Vietnamese collocation 'Công ty TNHH'; the name must not include a word or phrase identical to a registered trademark or misrepresenting the licensed securities / fund-management business (Articles 37-40, Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Articles 23-27, Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise name (absolute bar without ministerial approval)

Institutional tokens signifying state organs or public entities, including 'Chính phủ', 'Bộ', 'Tổng cục', 'Cục', 'Viện', 'Trường Đại học', 'Công an', 'Quân đội', requiring prior written approval of the relevant state authority

Sectoral tokens implying regulated financial activity without a licence, including 'Ngân hàng', 'Tín dụng', 'Chứng khoán', 'Quỹ đầu tư', 'Bảo hiểm', and English equivalents such as 'Bank', 'Securities', 'Fund', 'Asset Management', 'Multi-Family Office', where the token suggests discretionary portfolio management, requiring prior approval of the State Bank of Viet Nam or the State Securities Commission
Words that violate national security, social order, public interests, or historical and cultural sensibilities
Trademark-infringing, deceptive, or derogatory expressions otherwise prohibited by civil and criminal statutes
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The National Business Registration Portal performs an automated similarity check at filing. If a name is rejected, the applicant may (i) immediately file a revised name on the portal using 3-5 pre-screened alternatives; or (ii) contest the rejection by submitting a written administrative complaint under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 to the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of the notice of rejection. A second-instance appeal lies to the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment. Thereafter, the applicant may initiate judicial review under the Law on Administrative Procedure No. 93/2015/QH14. No extension beyond the statutory 30-day name-reservation window is available except at the registry's discretion in force-majeure circumstances; all appeals must be accompanied by the rejection notice, the proposed alternative name, and evidence of the lawful distinctiveness of the name (e.g., prior trademark registration certificate).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted by Vietnamese practice for general FDI/LLC registration where the registered head-office address is supplied by a licensed business service center or 'virtual office' operator and is a real, serviceable Vietnamese address (not a P.O. Box) capable of receiving service of process, correspondence, and official notices (Article 42, Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Article 25, Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP). However, the multi-family office's discretionary portfolio advisory and quasi-securities licensing under the Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 155/2020/ND-CP requires the State Securities Commission to inspect actual premises, AML/CFT records, and client-asset safeguarding arrangements; a pure virtual office is not acceptable commercial substance for the State Securities Commission. Recommendation: lease a serviced-office suite of at least 40-60 square meters in a licensed business center in Ho Chi Minh City (District 1) or Hanoi (Hoan Kiem) for the licensed head office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: estimated 70-80% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection by the principal regulator (State Securities Commission), the State Bank of Viet Nam inspection unit (for ancillary payment and custody interactions), and tax authorities within the first 12-24 months after licensing. The risk rises to approximately 85% if custody wire and Swift interbank rails are used without a licensed intermediate custodian, reflecting the 'High_Risk_Special_License' AML risk tier and the enforcement policy under Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN and Decision No. 11/2018/QD-TTg.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Chapters III–IV, Articles 46–87: multi-member and single-member LLC formation, members' council, charter capital Articles 74–78); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 22, 25, 27–31, 33, 37–39: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and conditional business lines); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (as amended by Decree No. 123/2024/ND-CP); Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 (Articles 63–66, 69: fund management company and discretionary portfolio management); Decree No. 155/2020/ND-CP (fund management company license); Law on Prevention and Combating Money Laundering (as amended, effective 1 July 2025; current implementing Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI / Sở Kế hoạch và Đầu tư) of the province or central-affiliated municipality where the registered office is located; for projects within an Export Processing Zone, Industrial Park or High-Tech Zone, the Management Board of the Industrial Zone/EPZ (Ban Quản lý các Khu công nghiệp/Khu chế xuất/Khu công nghệ cao) exercises equivalent registration competence.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier for the Certificate of Enterprise Registration comprising Form I-1 Application for Enterprise Registration, Form I-2 List of Members, the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), and a valid Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) issued to the foreign investors; submitted through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) or in person at the DPI one-stop section. IRC issuance is free of charge; ERC issuance fee is VND 100,000 (≈ USD 4).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to an ordinary LLC under the Law on Enterprises; however, to lawfully render discretionary portfolio management for multi-family clients, the company must be licensed as a fund management company by the State Securities Commission and maintain charter capital of at least VND 25 billion (≈ USD 1,000,000) subscribed and fully paid-in. All contributed capital must be transferred to the company's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) within 90 days of the ERC (Article 75, Law on Enterprises), with the first 90-day phase held in a blocked escrow/capital-modality account at a licensed custodian bank and released only after the fund-management license and capital-dedicated verification by the SSC; late contributions subject the defaulting member to loss of voting rights and statutory default interest (Article 76).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FORMAL FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — RESOLUTION OF THE COUNCIL OF MEMBERS OF [COMPANY VIET NAM] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY. Adopted by unanimous written consent of all member representatives in lieu of a physical meeting, being lawful under Article 56 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Article 46 of the Company Charter. The Council notes that the Company was granted Investment Registration Certificate No. [___] and Certificate of Enterprise Registration No. [___], with the business scope of discretionary portfolio management and multi-family office advisory for private client families (ISIC 6430). NOW IT IS RESOLVED: 1. SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION OF CHARTER CAPITAL: all members ratify the subscribed charter capital of VND [25,000,000,000] allocated in the Schedule of Capital Contributions; each member shall contribute in lawful Vietnamese dong or freely convertible currency to the Company's DICA within 90 days of the ERC; any overdue contribution will follow the default-interest and voting-suspension regime of Articles 75–76. 2. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: the registered office is fixed at [full street address, ward, district, city], Vietnam; the legal representative is authorized to execute the premises lease, notarize the lease instrument as registration evidence, notify any later address change via the National Enterprise Registration Portal, and submit the office lease to the fire-safety and environmental registration authorities. 3. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS AND LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE: (a) [Name], Chairperson of the Council of Members; (b) [Name], General Director/Chief Executive Officer, appointed as sole legal representative of the Company with full powers to open bank accounts, sign contracts within VND [limit] per transaction, and appear before all authorities; (c) [Name], Chief Compliance Officer/Deputy General Director, responsible for the SSC license, AML/CFT program and custody-banking compliance; all remunerations, delegations and signatures to be filed in the specimen-signature register. 4. REGULATORY MANDATES: the Chairperson and General Director are jointly directed to apply without delay for the Fund Management Company Establishment and Operation License with the State Securities Commission; to deposit the blocked capital in the custodian-bank escrow; and to complete fire-safety, environmental registration and AML/CFT registration. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION: all officers are authorized to execute ancillary documents, to file this Resolution with the DPI, tax authority, banks and the SSC, and to take every lawful act necessary for the timely implementation of the foregoing. ADOPTED this ____ day of ______, 20__ at [place]. [Signature blocks: General Director/legal representative; Chairperson; witnesses].

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT), Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; nationwide e-tax filing and e-invoice portal: https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; enterprise registration portal: https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign investor obtains an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) where required by the Law on Investment and an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. Step 2: The tax authority automatically issues the statutory 10-digit tax identification number (MST) upon ERC issuance; no separate TIN application is required. Step 3: The taxpayer activates an electronic tax account on the GDT portal at https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn and registers a tax digital signature (USB token or cloud-based e-signature) for filing and e-invoice use. Step 4: A foreign contractor operating without a local legal entity that derives Vietnamese-source income must register directly for Foreign Contractor Tax using the applicable GDT form and obtain a tax code for withholding and compliance. Step 5: The LLC must register a physical tax administration place of business with the provincial tax office and file the standard taxpayer registration dossier for CIT, VAT, and withholdings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - A foreign-invested LLC is a separate Vietnamese tax resident by incorporation and place of management. It is subject to Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income and is treated as a distinct taxable person for VAT and Foreign Contractor Tax purposes. The LLC cannot be classified as a pass-through entity under Vietnamese tax law; profits distributed to foreign owners attract dividend withholding tax in accordance with the applicable double tax agreement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election and no hybrid mismatch pass-through election exists. Statutory elections and options available include: (i) VAT calculation method — the credit/deduction method is the default; eligible small taxpayers or foreign contractors may elect the direct turnover method; (ii) Foreign Contractor Tax election — a covered foreign contractor may elect to declare and pay itself or be subject to withholding; (iii) CIT incentive registration — the LLC must register qualifying investment activities with the tax authority to claim preferential CIT rates and exemptions; (iv) loss carryforward claims of up to five years are exercised in the annual CIT finalization; (v) treaty relief — a foreign resident contractor may invoke an applicable double tax agreement by filing Vietnamese domestic returns and providing a valid tax residency certificate. Hybrid mismatch conversion is not available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax under Law No. 13/2008/QH12, as amended by Law No. 06/2017/QH14; no separate GST system)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold applies to incorporated LLCs: every LLC with taxable supplies in Viet Nam must be VAT-registered before starting activity. Small household businesses with annual turnover from taxable goods and services not exceeding VND 100 million are outside the VAT net and need not register unless they voluntarily register. A foreign contractor deriving Vietnamese-source revenue becomes liable under the Foreign Contractor Tax regime from the first invoice, with no minimum economic threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing is mandatory under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. All sales invoices must be issued as e-invoices in standardized XML format, digitally signed, containing QR codes, and transmitted to the General Department of Taxation through the national e-invoice portal. The regime uses both e-invoices with tax-authority-generated invoice codes and e-invoices without pre-allocated codes, but all invoice data must be submitted to the GDT through certified software or authorized intermediation APIs in the prescribed post-issuance period. There is no physical stamping requirement; fiscal compliance is achieved through schema validation, digital signature integrity, QR code, and near-real-time electronic transmission to the GDT.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to exported goods and export services. For goods: there must be an export contract, customs clearance, and physical export out of Vietnamese territory. For services: the services must be provided to a foreign organization or individual and consumed wholly outside Viet Nam, supported by a service contract, foreign-currency remittance evidence, and proof of offshore use. For the target multi-family office scope, discretionary portfolio advisory services supplied to non-resident private-client families can qualify as zero-rated only where the client is located outside Viet Nam, the advice is not consumed inside Viet Nam, and fees are paid from abroad; services linked to Vietnamese assets or consumed in Viet Nam do not qualify. Input VAT attributable to zero-rated supplies is creditable/refundable.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If export zero-rating is claimed without the required customs, logistics, or foreign-payment evidence, the tax authority recharacterizes the supply as domestic and assesses VAT at 10% on the gross consideration, disallows related input VAT, claws back refunds previously paid, and charges late-payment interest at 0.03% per day. Administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP range from 20% of the underdeclared tax for ordinary misdeclaration to 1–3 times the tax shortfall for tax evasion. Fraudulent export schemes may trigger suspension of invoices, bank account freezes, denial of further VAT refunds, and criminal liability under the Penal Code for tax evasion or smuggling, including imprisonment for serious cases. The statutory limitation period is extended to 10 years for acts of tax evasion or fraudulent non-filing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Bank of Vietnam (SBV; Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam), established under the Law on the State Bank of Vietnam No. 46/2010/QH12, is the sole monetary and foreign-exchange authority in the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. FX administration is governed by the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 06/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 (as amended by Ordinance No. 16/2012/UBTVQH13), Government Decree No. 70/2014/ND-CP detailing foreign-exchange management, and SBV Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN on foreign-exchange transactions with residents and non-residents (as amended by Circular No. 05/2021/TT-NHNN). The SBV grants banking licences, authorizes approved banks to deal in foreign currencies and derivatives, supervises correspondent banking and cross-border payment systems, operates the interbank foreign-exchange market, fixes the official reference exchange rate and daily band, and annually determines any mandatory sale ratio on foreign-currency export receipts. For an MFO treasury, SBV licenses are not directly held, but the operating Vietnamese LLC must act exclusively through SBV-licensed credit institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese dong (VND) is a managed-float, partially convertible currency under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange and Decree 70/2014/ND-CP. Current-account items, genuinely evidenced by invoices and contracts, are freely transferable through licensed banks using the correct balance-of-payments (BOP) purpose codes: trade in goods and services, interest, royalties, management fees and profit remittances may be routed without prior SBV approval, subject to underlying documentation and to tax withholding clearance. Capital-account items are open but tightly administratively controlled: inward FDI equity must enter through a licensed bank's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) against an executed Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); intercompany loans and offshore borrowing require a PCL/FX-coded foreign-loan registration certificate; portfolio investments by the MFO in Vietnamese securities require a securities custody and investor code if the LLC is a foreign institutional investor. Profit remittance hurdles for the foreign investor are sequential: audited annual financial statements of the LLC, corporate income tax (CIT) and foreign contractor tax (FCT) finalization, resolution declaring distributable after-tax profit, documentary proof that the registered charter capital has been contributed, and bank verification of the DICA outflow. In practice, tier-1 Vietnamese banks apply high-level EDD to discretionary portfolio-advisory flows, and the LLC should be prepared for source-of-funds review on every material outbound profit transfer. Convertibility is therefore unrestricted on the current account but gated on the capital account, and both directions require purpose codes and full bankable documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Article 32 of Decree 70/2014/ND-CP and Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN, exporters of goods and services must repatriate export proceeds into a foreign-currency demand deposit account (FCA) held at a licensed Vietnamese bank within 90 days from completion of the export customs declaration (or within the contractually agreed payment term for deferred-payment exports, but never beyond the statutory limit). Repatriation must be in the invoiced convertible currency or another freely convertible currency acceptable to the SBV. The SBV publishes an annual Decision setting the mandatory conversion ratio for each foreign-currency receipt category; from the 2016 cycle through the most recently published Decisions, the applicable ratio for general merchandise and commercial export earnings has been 0%, meaning exporters may retain 100% of export proceeds in FCAs and convert voluntarily at onshore licence bank rates. If the MFO treasury generates any exported service income, the same 90-day repatriation rule applies; such receipts are not stranded abroad. Mandatory surrender can be reintroduced at any time by SBV Decision, and the treasury must monitor in force Decisions rather than assume permanent 0% retention.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low, and legally unfit as a primary onshore treasury. Vietnamese law does not recognize offshore digital EMI institutions as authorized credit institutions; the Law on Credit Institutions (2024) confines deposit-taking, payment-account and foreign-exchange services to SBV-licensed Vietnamese banks and licensed foreign bank branches. Offshore EMIs such as global multi-currency payout platforms cannot open VND payment accounts, cannot operate as a DICA, cannot receive FDI equity, cannot remit after-tax profits to foreign shareholders, and cannot file tax payments in Viet Nam. They may be used only as ancillary FX/payout technology in the non-VND leg: funds are first held in and disbursed from the Vietnamese licensed bank, and an EMI can provide street-level payout routing in third currencies under a bank-approved payment-agency arrangement, but the legal account relationship remains with the Vietnamese bank. The MFO treasury blueprint must therefore treat the tier-1 Vietnamese bank as the sole regulated clearing venue and any fintech/EMI as a supplementary payment interface, never as the DICA or settlement account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for corporate account opening in the Vietnamese CDD regime. Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 01/2022/QH15 (effective 01/03/2023) and SBV Circular 09/2023/TT-NHNN on customer identification and beneficial ownership, the bank must identify the legal representative and every beneficial owner before opening the core operating account; for a High_Risk_Special_License multi-family-office entity with discretionary advisory scope, tier-1 banks require at least one in-person KYC interview at the Vietnamese branch for the legal representative and typically each 25%-plus beneficial owner. Remote video verification is possible only when the bank operates an approved e-KYC framework, the customer risk rating is not high, and no sanction/PEP finding exists; for this file, banks treat MFO-type activity as inherently high risk and will require personal appearance. Where directors are non-resident and cannot travel, the acceptable alternative is a notarized and consular-legalized power of attorney appointing a resident CFO/director, a certified corporate kit (IRC, ERC, articles, name-dossier, identity and address proofs, certificate of good standing from the foreign registry, apostilled passports), plus a live videoconference interview with each UBO; even then, the bank may escalate and request a subsequent physical appearance by at least one principal after onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Entity classified under ISIC 6430 as a multi-family office with discretionary portfolio advisory authority, triggering automatic Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) and mandatory referral to the bank's Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and Head-Office Risk Committee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (i) Vietnamese securities license or State Securities Commission (SSC) authorization confirming the lawful scope of portfolio advisory/management, or a reasoned licensed-institution wrapper with the MFO as an adviser; (ii) enterprise registration and investment certificates; (iii) the firm's internal AML-CFT manual, customer acceptance policy, transaction monitoring procedure, and independent audit report of the AML function; (iv) appointment certificates of the AML Compliance Officer and Data Protection Officer; (v) two years of audited financial statements and an external audit management letter; (vi) a detailed business plan showing expected transaction velocity, beneficiary classes, and source-of-wealth profile of founding families.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners domiciled in offshore financial centres or jurisdictions with enhanced transparency risk, or where the legal ownership chain contains multi-tier holding structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership-chain maps down to natural persons; tax residence certificates and personal/CV dossier for each UBO; three years of certified financial statements for each intermediate holding entity; evidence of real economic substance (staff, office, local licenses, tax filings) from the intermediate jurisdictions; independent legal opinion from Vietnamese counsel on the beneficial ownership register; sanctions/negative-media screening reports; reference letters from top-tier global banks holding the family relationship; and notarized appointments of the Vietnamese legal representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverifiable source of wealth or source of funds for the initial charter capital and for family assets that will be placed under MFO discretionary advice, including concern over crypto-derived or unregulated-channel funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A sworn Source of Wealth (SoW) and Source of Funds (SoF) memorandum per UBO supported by capital-gains tax records, broker confirmations, sale-and-purchase agreements, inheritance deeds, trust deeds, legacy constructors, shareholder distribution minutes, and audited financial statements of originating companies; 24 months of bank statements from top-tier international banks; certification that no direct or indirect crypto exchange flows are accepted; and a written group policy prohibiting cash-intensive or crypto-denominated funding into the MFO treasury.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: No Vietnamese operating history and absence of a tax dossier; correspondent bank concern that the account will be used to circulate family wealth globally without a clear Vietnamese economic purpose.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed IRC/ERC with MFO scope explicitly stated; tax identification card and initial CIT/VAT registration filings; advance corporate income tax payment certificates; model of Vietnamese value-creation: local licensed staff, office, compliance function, fixed fee agreements with foreign family clients, stated Vietnamese treasury hub rationale; payment-trail undertaking that all flows will be supported by invoices, custody statements and BOP purpose codes; and written comfort that the account will never be used for pure pass-through transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Person (PEP) identification among family-office principals or founders, or surname/family connections to senior political figures, triggering stratified senior-level approval.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prompt, documented PEP declaration at pre-onboarding stage with detailed public-profile appendix; source-of-funds evidence sourced exclusively through the regulated financial system; written risk assessment and mitigation plan by the MLRO; enhanced periodic review and transaction monitoring agreement; inclusion of all specified individuals in customer risk-rating documentation; and banking approval via the Head-Office MLRO and Credit Committee with audit trail.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign MFO shareholders subscribe in USD, EUR, SGD or JPY and transfer principal through SWIFT MT103 customer credit (or MT202 cover for any bank-to-bank leg) to the LLC's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at the chosen SBV-licensed bank. The remittance narrative must contain the LLC legal name, the IRC/ERC reference, the investing entity's full identification, and the BOP purpose code for an inward direct-investment equity contribution (within Annex 01 to SBV Circular 16/2015/TT-NHNN on statistical information, category 'Direct investment into a Vietnamese entity' / equity capital, commonly coded 2101, and as last published by the SBV bank of issue office). The receiving bank verifies: (i) the corporate dossier matches the IRC and ERC; (ii) the remitter is the registered investor; (iii) the charter capital schedule supports the transfer; (iv) sanction and OFAC/EU/UN screening passes; (v) the purpose code reconciles with the established customer profile. Upon receipt, the DICA is credited, a foreign-exchange/ITRS report is forwarded to the SBV within the regulatory deadline, and the LLC can use funds only for registered investment objects: local office infrastructure, payroll conversions, professional indemnity insurance, tax payments, permitted warehouse stock, and direct operating expenses. Client assets under MFO discretion must never be commingled with the DICA or the operational account: discretionary securities positions remain in custody accounts of licensed custodians under the Securities Law, while family-office cash sweeps on behalf of clients require separate banking approval and fiduciary structuring to avoid anti-money-laundering red flags. An IRS/vendor/landlord payment run is executed only after the bank sees invoices and underlying contracts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlement of trade, advisory, and treasury obligations, the LLC uses the following clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 customer credit for direct outbound wires covering genuine current-account disbursements such as management/advisory fees to the foreign MFO network, software licensing, professional services, subscriptions and trading costs, each line item supported by contract, invoice, tax withholding receipt (CIT/FCT/VAT where applicable) and correct outbound BOP purpose code; (2) commercial documentary Letters of Credit issued under SWIFT MT700/701/707 and UCP600 for contract-driven procurement of equipment or software where large-value protection is needed, with presentation of transport/acceptance documents through the Vietnamese bank's trade-desk; (3) the SBV Interbank Electronic Payment System (IBPS) for VND-denominated domestic treasury moves (payroll, office rent, taxes, local overheads) following conversion of USD through the licensed bank at spot or forward prices; (4) documentary collections (MT400/MT410) for low-risk dealer transactions; and (5) DICA-mediated dividend remittance by foreign shareholders, executed only after the annual statutory audit, CIT/FCT finalization, distribution resolution and the bank's EDD review, using the BOP purpose code for distributed investment income. USD-leg settlement flows cross the global correspondent net (e.g., CHIPS/Fedwire through the bank's U.S. correspondents), euro-leg flows use TARGET2 through European correspondents, and the local VND leg always settles via the SBV-owned IBPS. Cash concentration architecture should keep a two-to-three-day VND operating float to avoid holding unproductive dong, converting excess VND back into the source currency immediately.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: on-shore deliverable FX forward contracts for USD/EUR/CNY/JPY versus VND with a licensed Vietnamese bank, tenor capped at 365 days, supported by genuine underlying commercial or capital transactions, and collateralized through bank credit lines or cash margin in compliance with Circular 15/2015/TT-NHNN as amended

FX swap transactions (spot versus forward) with the same licensed bank designed to finance short-term VND cash flow while preserving USD treasury value, each leg having underlying trade/payroll rationale documented in the bank's treasury mandate

cross-currency swaps (principally USD/VND and multi-currency swap structures) for medium-to-long-term matching of foreign-investor capital and repatriation schedules, permitted when the maturity mirrors the registered commercial loan or investment tenor and when conducted by a licensed credit institution

FX options including zero-cost collars purchased from licensed banks to hedge adverse VND/USD movement on forecast profit remittances, allowed only as hedging instruments for an existing or genuinely anticipated underlying foreign-exchange exposure, never for speculative option writing

strictly no onshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs); offshore NDF contracts referencing VND are prohibited for Vietnamese treasury purposes because the SBV requires deliverable settlement through licensed Vietnamese banks, and any such instrument would constitute an unauthorized FX transaction

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Form 03/TNDN) with annual financial statements and finalization schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Office under the General Department of Taxation (GDT) of Viet Nam
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the year following the fiscal year (within 90 calendar days from fiscal year-end, December 31); for approved non-December fiscal year-end, within 90 days of that fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day on unpaid tax; administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP of VND 5,000,000 to 8,000,000 for late filing, up to VND 25,000,000 for repeat offenses; forced collection by bank garnishment, suspension of VAT invoice issuance, and administrative dissolution risk for persistent non-filing under Law on Enterprises 2020 Article 215

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax Finalization (Form 5A-KK-TNCN) for employees and service providers subject to Vietnamese withholding
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Office of the enterprise payroll registration jurisdiction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the year following the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines of VND 5,000,000 to 8,000,000 and repeat-offense fines up to VND 25,000,000 under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; late payment interest of 0.03% per day on unpaid withheld amounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Fee (Lệ phí môn bài) payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Office as collection agent for the State Treasury
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 31 of each calendar year; newly established enterprises must pay within 30 days of enterprise registration certificate issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day; administrative fines of VND 2,000,000 to 7,000,000 under Decree 109/2013/ND-CP as amended by Decree 22/2020/ND-CP

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements with independent auditor's report (unconditional audit requirement for foreign-invested enterprises)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via the Provincial Tax Office, Department of Planning and Investment, State Securities Commission and State Bank of Vietnam, as applicable to the licensed multi-family office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 (within 90 days after fiscal year-end); audit engagement must be concluded before the financial statement closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of VND 8,000,000 to 15,000,000 for failure to submit audited financial statements under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP; audited financial statements are a prerequisite for CIT finalization and annual securities license reporting; continued failure triggers license sanctions and administrative dissolution procedures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Project Implementation Report (Báo cáo tình hình thực hiện dự án đầu tư)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or economic zone where the Investment Registration Certificate was issued
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the following year (within 90 days of fiscal year-end) per Decree 31/2021/ND-CP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Warning or fine up to VND 5,000,000 under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP as amended by Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated failure is a statutory ground for suspension or termination of the investment project under Law on Investment 2020 Article 76

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Anti-Money Laundering Compliance Report including updated beneficial ownership (UBO) confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Bank of Vietnam - Anti-Money Laundering Department (SBV-AMLD) and, in parallel, the State Securities Commission for licensed investment advisory entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the year following the reporting year (within 90 days of fiscal year-end) per Law on AML 2022 and Decree 35/2022/ND-CP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of VND 30,000,000 to 200,000,000 under Decree 117/2022/ND-CP; serious or repeated AML compliance failure may trigger suspension or revocation of the special investment advisory / multi-family office license

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Securities Business / Portfolio Advisory License Report filed together with the audited annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Securities Commission of Viet Nam (SSC) - Non-Banking Finance Supervision Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the year following the fiscal year (within 90 days of fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-submission fine of VND 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 and substantive reporting violations subject to fines up to VND 100,000,000 under Decree 156/2020/ND-CP; the SSC may issue corrective orders, suspend operations, or revoke the operating license for repeated non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required for: (i) all foreign-invested enterprises, including the VN LLC, irrespective of size, under Decree 05/2021/ND-CP; (ii) securities companies, fund managers, and investment advisory licensees such as the multi-family office; (iii) credit and financial institutions supervised by the State Bank of Vietnam; (iv) enterprises with average total assets of VND 60 billion or more, or annual revenue of VND 120 billion or more, in the preceding year under Decree 05/2021/ND-CP; (v) parent companies controlling one or more subsidiaries
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) under Law on Accounting 2015 and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC (full regime) or Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC (SME regime); micro-enterprise accounting regime under Circular 53/2025/TT-BTC for eligible small entities; IFRS permitted for foreign-invested subsidiaries meeting the criteria of Decree 28/2024/ND-CP

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law on AML 2022 and Decree 35/2022/ND-CP, the multi-family office must identify and verify every beneficial owner (natural person holding 25% or more of equity or exercising control) at onboarding and refresh the UBO register at least annually, and additionally within 10 days of any share transfer or ownership change registered in the National Enterprise Registration Database. The annual UBO confirmation statement is embedded in the AML compliance report submitted to SBV-AMLD by March 31. For SSC-licensed entities, the annual report must declare major shareholders and UBO changes. Any equity transfer must be simultaneously recorded in the statutory Register of Members and notified to the DPI within 10 days of the transfer
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder registry with capital contribution history) maintained at the registered office under Law on Enterprises 2020 Article 51
Minute Book containing charter, contribution records, resolutions and meeting minutes of the Members' Council and General Director
Register of Directors / General Director and authorized signatories
Beneficial Ownership Register maintained under the AML Law 2022 and Decree 35/2022/ND-CP

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 - 4,500 per annum for a licensed-address virtual office or corporate agent service in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - 15,000 per annum for a VAS audit of a small multi-family office financial entity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% (standard CIT rate in Vietnam; no differentiated federal/provincial surcharge for this LLC)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None for a multi-family office under ISIC 6430 / NAICS 523920; the effective CIT rate remains 20%. Tax holidays and preferential rates apply only to defined incentivised sectors such as high-technology enterprises, qualifying industrial manufacturing in economic zones, and scale-compliant investment projects. Fee-based discretionary portfolio advisory does not qualify for any statutory CIT holiday or preferential deduction.
